entries.description: Local C# wine buyer using the GitHub Copilot SDK and A2A v1 JSON-RPC. Discovers supplier Agent Cards through its configured AI Catalog.
Rust wine supplier: Copilot natural-language quotes and orders, deterministic v1 wine RFQ/order data parts. Delivery throughout the US and Canada.
